meta.name: Logística moderna ASLI — v2 (evolución 2026)
meta.description: Identidad visual moderna y portuario-corporativa para el sitio público de ASLI, centrada en servicios logísticos y comercio exterior. V2 evoluciona la base editorial hacia bento grids, mesh gradients animados y marquee, manteniendo paleta y tipografía.
source_references: https://pymewebapp.com/ — layout conversional, cards suaves, scroll reveals
Brief: tono moderno, servicios como eje de conversión
Brief v2: landing comercialmente más atractiva, últimos patrones visuales, sin romper identidad

neutral.usage: Cream para superficies claras; navy para texto y fondos institucionales

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast — navy/teal over cream or white; white over navy hero imagery

typography.font_style_notes: Syne display geométrica con carácter; Manrope humanista limpia para lectura. Evitar Inter/Roboto/Arial.

spacing.section_rhythm: py-20 md:py-28 between major sections; tighter within service rows

layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric — brand and services left-weighted on desktop

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px on light surfaces; hairline dividers between service rows

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping image crops, soft shadows, tonal shifts cream/navy

iconography.preferred_set: inline SVG custom strokes matching teal

motion.philosophy: minimal functional — 2–3 intentional motions, never decorative spam

components.button_style: rectangular low-radius solid teal primary; ghost navy outline secondary; no pill shapes
components.input_style: light surface, 1px border neutral, focus ring teal/30
components.card_style: avoid cards by default; when needed: flat surface, hairline border, no heavy shadow
components.navigation_pattern: sticky navy bar, hamburger sheet, brand logos left
components.modal_style: elevated white panel over dark overlay
components.list_style: asymmetric bento grid — one dominant tile + varied secondary tiles, real photos with gradient veil
components.component_notes: Services are bento tiles (never identical check-icon cards); trust logos run as an infinite CSS marquee, pausable on hover; contact panels use a subtle glass-panel over mesh-gradient backgrounds

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: puerto + fruta + ruta: movimiento limpio del origen al destino

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents — grain overlay, teal hairlines
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: hero and services carry most weight; trust logos lighter
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element then progressive service reveal
visual_language.texture_usage: subtle film grain on cream surfaces; photographic realism in service imagery

composition.grouping_strategy: services clustered; trust logos in one quiet band
composition.negative_space_role: breathing room that signals premium clarity

imagery.photo_treatment: full-bleed hero with dark gradient veil; service photos cropped edge-to-edge with teal-navy overlay on hover
imagery.graphic_elements: hairline rules, overline labels, grain texture
imagery.pattern_usage: optional faint diagonal grain, not decorative patterns
imagery.image_shape: rectangular sharp corners; avoid rounded media cards

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: image scale 1.04 + overlay deepen; link underline/teal
interaction_feel.loading_style: soft pulse on dolar widget only

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative — Ver servicios / Acceder / Cotizar

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS — disable grain and scroll reveals if prefers-reduced-motion

background_effects.description: Subtle SVG/CSS grain overlay on cream page backgrounds at low opacity

text_effects.description: Hero text enters with CSS fade-up only

image_effects.description: Service images gently scale and darken on hover; ken-burns disabled

glassmorphism_neumorphism.style: restrained glass — one panel per dark section, never stacked cards

params.shadow_type: none — relies on backdrop blur only

visual_effects.composite_notes: v2: still CSS-only, no WebGL/particles/3D. Added: animated mesh-gradient aurora (radial blends of teal/accent/navy, 18–22s drift, disabled on prefers-reduced-motion) on hero and dark sections; infinite marquee for trust logo strips (pauses on hover); bento grid replaces alternating rows for services (one dominant tile, mixed spans, hover scale 1.08 + deepen); text-gradient-accent for one emphasis word per major headline; hover-lift (translateY -4px + shadow-high) on buttons/cards. Glass-panel (blur 16px, 6% white fill) is the one deliberate exception to 'avoid cards', reserved for contact/info panels over mesh-gradient dark sections — not used elsewhere.
